description: Hybrid v0.2 reference (reconciled 2026-11-09): v1.4/v1.7-style topology, hybrid anchors S002+S003 cross-checked with S001/S013 (provenance-labeled; not a verified Fulltone netlist). True-bypass core, 8-18V DC center-negative (5V dropped by explicit user decision), most-available parts/substitutions allowed with provenance, D003 BAT46 default + Ge/1N4148 options, no buffer default. D002: validate TL082 at 8-18V (min supply 7V typ per S007 opened 2026-11-09; 8V CM/swing unverified). DAFx26 v2 table used as exploration baseline only.

architecture.summary: Input -> Gain1(TL082 candidate, Drive) -> Clip(2N7000+Ge/Schottky options to Vref) -> Gain2(TL082 candidate) -> Tone/HP-LP/Volume -> Out; true bypass

requirements.acceptance: No damage/oscillation; functional audio at 8V, 9V, and 18V into 100k load under stated conditions (input level/frequency TBD)
Dry signal passed when off; active circuit isolated per implementation

requirements.text: Asymmetric OCD-style clipping character with HP/LP voicing
requirements.acceptance: Qualitative + simulation waveform/spectrum under stated conditions (TBD); not a verified Fulltone clone claim
Within TBD tolerance across 8-18V (verify per locked divider)

risks.risk: TL082 CM/swing/headroom may be insufficient at 8V single supply (condition/process/temperature dependent)
risks.mitigation: Verify SLOS081O limits (S007) + provenance-tracked SPICE/bench at 8/9/18V; substitute only with datasheet/SPICE provenance and recorded decision (D002)

risks.risk: 1N34A Ge diode variability shifts clipping symmetry/threshold
risks.mitigation: Select/measure diodes or design for tolerance; D003 allows BAT46/1N4148 options with provenance

risks.risk: Exact schematic values/orientation not a verified Fulltone netlist
risks.mitigation: Hybrid working reference S002+S003 cross-checked with S001/S013; label unverified items; confirm pin-level values/orientation against traceable schematic+datasheets before fabrication
